description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR@10) performance across four different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) configurations as the number of queries used during inference increases from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linearly scaled from 1 to 10, with tick labels appearing at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is linearly scaled from 33.0 to 36.0. The plot displays four distinct lines: the black solid line represents “DPR w/o query,” which remains constant at approximately 34.4 throughout the entire range; the red line with circular markers, “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” starts at approximately 35.2 when S=1 and steadily increases to a peak of approximately 35.8 near S=4 before slightly declining to approximately 35.7 at S=10; the green line with triangular markers, “DPR w/ document expansion,” begins at approximately 34.9 and exhibits minor fluctuations around a mean value of approximately 34.95; and the blue line with star markers, “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion,” starts at approximately 34.9, dips to a low of approximately 34.4 near S=6, and continues to decline to approximately 34.5 at S=10.
